title: Draw directly on a board
summary: Mark a boundary, write an observation, or rough out a process beside your notes.
benefit: Add quick visual thoughts without creating a separate drawing card.
outcome: Editable freehand marks sit beside your references and stay where you drew them.

sections.title: Put a thought beside your references
paragraphs: Draw a loose boundary around reference images, add a handwritten observation, or rough out a process alongside written requirements. Completed marks stay editable.

flow.entry: Open an editable board and choose Draw in the tools.

steps.action: Choose Pen or Highlighter, then a colour and width.
steps.result: The chosen settings are shown in the drawing controls. Highlighter marks are translucent.

steps.action: Drag on the board and release the pointer.
steps.result: Your completed mark stays on the board. Make another mark to continue.

steps.action: Hold Space and drag to pan, then release Space.
steps.result: The board moves temporarily; you can draw again after releasing Space.
Drawing mode ends and you can select finished marks.

flow.completion: Completed marks save as you draw and remain editable when you reopen the board. Watch the save status before closing.
flow.correction: Press Escape during a gesture to cancel only the unfinished mark. Press Escape when idle to leave drawing. Undo restores the previous completed action.

flow.entry: Choose Done, then click a visible mark to select it.

steps.action: Drag the selected mark, or use its resize handle.
steps.result: The mark moves or scales while keeping its proportions.

steps.action: Choose Next mark when marks overlap.
steps.result: The selection cycles between overlapping canvas marks.

steps.action: Choose Edit drawing, or press Enter with one mark selected.
steps.result: The drawing tools reopen for that mark. Editing stays within its boundary; use Draw for a new mark elsewhere.

steps.action: Choose Lock position in the selection bar.
steps.result: The mark stays in place while you arrange nearby content. Its drawing content remains editable.

flow.completion: Choose Done to keep the completed edits and return to the board. Choose Unlock position before moving or resizing a locked mark.
flow.correction: Use Undo or Redo to correct a completed change. Select a mark and choose Bury for recoverable deletion; restore it from Buried bones.

sections.title: What moves with what?
paragraphs: Ink drawn directly on the board stays where you drew it when nearby cards move. Move the ink separately when needed.
Annotations on an image move and resize with that image. Strokes inside a sketch follow the sketch card.
Freehand marks do not attach automatically to nearby cards. Use a connector for a structured relationship between cards.

figures.alt: An annotated reference image at upper left, a white sketch card at lower right, and a separate red freehand mark directly on the board.
figures.caption: Board ink remains separate while annotations and sketch strokes follow their moved and resized cards.

flow.entry: Choose Draw, or reopen a selected mark with Edit drawing.

steps.action: Choose Eraser and drag across marks.
steps.result: Whole strokes are removed, including translucent highlighter strokes.
The strokes removed by that continuous erasing gesture return.

flow.completion: Choose Done when the drawing is ready.
flow.correction: Redo applies the erasure again. Escape cancels an unfinished gesture while keeping earlier completed marks.

sections.title: Reopen and export
paragraphs: Completed marks save as you draw. Offline changes stay on the device and sync when the connection returns. Reopen the board to continue editing its marks.
If local saving reports a problem, keep the window open and choose Retry saving. A working network connection does not replace saving on the device.

Use Export as PNG in the board menu for the board or a selection. Marks are included; drawing controls, selection handles and lock indicators are left out. Choose a transparent background when you want only board content.

figures.alt: A red horizontal stroke with transparent space around it and no editing controls.
figures.caption: PNG export includes the selected stroke and leaves selection tools out.

sections.title: Availability and limits
paragraphs: You need permission to edit the board to draw, erase or change marks. View-only visitors can see them.
Finish the current mark before zooming. Changing the view or interrupting the pointer cancels an unfinished mark; earlier completed marks remain.
If a mark reaches the drawing limit, release the pointer and start another mark. The visible part of the current mark is kept when you release.
This guide covers mouse and trackpad input. Pressure-sensitive pen and Pencil behavior is not documented here.

sections.title: Keyboard shortcuts
paragraphs: Space + drag temporarily pans. Escape cancels the current mark; when idle it leaves drawing. Enter edits one selected mark. Command+Z on Mac or Control+Z elsewhere undoes; add Shift to redo.
